scope: Analytically height-bounded C-infinity rounded-stadium collar search. Production data unchanged.
objective: Primary: smallest largest-found principal curvature within recorded dimensions. Secondary: worst meridian/helical display margin. This is a best-found numerical search, not a proof of global optimality.

localRefinement.numericalCaveat: A bounded, finite best-found search, not a global optimality theorem. Near-tie silhouettes may be chosen on secondary visibility or aesthetic grounds.
